sentences.en: We had native guides on our trip to the mountain.
sentences.zh: 我们去山里的旅行有当地向导。

sentences.en: Our guide misinformed us about the location of the hotel.
sentences.zh: 我们的导游错误地告诉我们酒店的位置。

sentences.en: Refer to the Users' Guide if you have any problems.
sentences.zh: 如果你有问题，请参阅用户指南。

senses.zh: 导游者，领路者，指南，路标
